criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: LOOK V2 throughout. S1, S3, S5, S8 strong at thumb size. S7 blade flat on a plain mat in the bottom third, borescope a blue stick, tag reads as a price tag. S4 two primitive boxes with glass blocks, a 3D bar chart. S9 splits into a dark engine on a dark wall and small cases on a washed apron. S5 headline '4' of 480 renders thin and outlined. S3 gold tape muddies the count.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One palette and type system; gold as software output where declared; engine bookends; S8 caliche map outside the material vocabulary but declared.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces; in testing and ceilings held; provided never fielded. Single release disclosed; S1 'AI maintenance tools' covers both though only FSUI is called AI enabled; S9 watch line implies AvMC will publish service results.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Who, where and funder named; action thin; Texas stake abstract; 480 hour phase unexplained.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover a statement; S2 to S3 setup and payoff; S3 to S5 three statistics in a row; S8 movable; S9 lands the turn last.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: House rules hold; clean register, generic Texas; caption hook a misdirection; S7 dek flat.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Fresh machine-lens concept; hero-in-sweep opener and county relief familiar.

one_sentence_fix: Explain the 480 hour phase in place of S8 and give S9 a concrete sourced next step.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Blade flat on a featureless mat in the bottom third; blank hangar slabs; stick-like borescope; price-tag tag.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Bench edge camera, foam tray filling half the frame, gloved hand with lit borescope tip, door light as rim.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Primitive blocks on a flat field read as a 3D bar chart; volume bar highlight blown.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Granite plate and parallels at a lower camera, key down a stop on the volume bar, ghost edge refraction.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Split composition with no single dominant subject at feed size.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Engine in the door light with the apron as rim, cases forward into the light pool.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The 4 of 480 renders thin and outlined beside the bold 80.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Force lining figures or the same weight for headline numerals and re-render.
